diagnosis.text: DIAGNOSIS: When inventory is full, CODM inserts a secondary "Inventory full — Item has been sent to Mail / TAP TO CONTINUE" popup that appears *after* the standard reward animation — too late for the existing `dismiss_after_tap` taps at `(200,200)` to catch it; the patience-round BACK recovery never fires because `total_tapped == expected` (1 of 1), so the popup sits unclosed for all 3 empty patience rounds and then blocks cooldown OCR too.
